svg.title: Technology Stack
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#. Frontend: React, HTML, CSS. Backend: Node.js, FastAPI. Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL. AI: Artificial Intelligence. Infrastructure and DevOps: Git, GitHub, Docker. Git Logo by Jason Long and HTML5/CSS3 identity by W3C, CC-BY-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), adapted to monochrome via Simple Icons.
